lesson: A control built from an infinite prime set has its zero by theorem, not by data: finite truncations carry no zero, and a numerical enclosure left of b needs an explicit Hoheisel-type bound at all scales. POS and unimodular parameters at every rational prime together identify zeta, so THIN and DEL between them cover every degree-one Euler-product read set without FE or periodicity.
